notes.title: Retirement
notes.notes: [p]****July 1, 2025 Update: Looks like steam is taking their sweet time with responding to my ticket requesting the game to be taken down. I'm not taking back my decision to retire the game. Additionally, I give my full permission to anyone that wishes to upload any of the previous depots wherever they choose.[/p][p][/p][p]This is a story about imperfection.[/p][p][/p][p]This is a story about the men that fell through the cracks into the abyss.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Saccharine Pale will become lost media in 3 days, so back up all the depots that you can. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your support and kindness.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope that this saccharine gem will bring joy and inspiration for years to come.[/p][p][/p][p]The fate of the Pale is in your capable hands now, young seekers of secrets.[/p][p][/p][p]I am so proud of all of you for having the courage to live your life.[/p][p][/p][p]Do not let hatred consume you. Do not let fear paralyze you. [/p][p][/p][p]Goodbye for now. Saccharine Pale is entering the public domain. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
